_about: Music for the titles and end credits, rendered locally from a public-domain score: no recording rights are involved.

make_music.py reads this file.  Each cue takes a range of measures from the score, plays it on a General MIDI harpsichord through FluidSynth with the FluidR3 GM SoundFont (MIT License), and stretches it to the exact length of its clip.

'anchors' pin a measure's downbeat to a time in the clip, so the music hits the title's beats; the tempo changes smoothly between anchors.  make_music.py warns when a stretch runs more than 'max_tempo_change' away from the median tempo.
Measure numbers are those of the score file; 'source.file' must be filled in before any cue can render.

source.piece: Domenico Scarlatti, Keyboard Sonata in G minor, K. 30 (L. 499), "Cat Fugue"
source._comment: A MIDI or MusicXML file of K. 30 from a public-domain edition, for example an engraving of the Longo edition (Ricordi, 1906-1913).  Record where it came from and its license here; put the file in series/music/.

soundfont.credit: FluidR3 GM SoundFont, Frank Wen (MIT License)

opening._comment: Main title (20 s) plus subtitle (6 s).  Anchor times are the title's beat starts: fly-in 2.0, kitten 5.5, dot 9.0, title 12.0, tagline 16.0, subtitle 20.0.

credits._comment: The credits roll plus its tail; its length comes from each episode's s99.
